cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 25 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 25 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 10 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: mid — the bigger up-leg is maturing
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 10 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its SECOND half ('right-translated') — strong cycles top late, a healthy-uptrend sign.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在后半段见顶（“右移”）——强周期见顶偏晚，属于健康上涨趋势的信号。

ladder.why_zh: 失败周期——价格跌破了启动本周期的低点，历史上这通常意味着更大的趋势正在掉头向下（约 80% 的情形）。
ladder.next_zh: 观望，直至新的日线周期低点形成并确认。

ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：下跌趋势。大局（顺势）：看多。
points_zh: 大局为看多（对日线多头而言属顺势）

ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ DOWNTREND signal triggered 2 trading days ago (~2026-06-17), switching from NEARING A LOW. Signal strength: strong (score -80/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 下跌趋势信号于 2 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-17），自接近低点切换而来。 信号强度：强（评分 -80/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱卖出/离场形态（-21）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✓ · 3日 ✗ · 周线 ✗ · 月线 ✗
ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_knife_line: ⚠ Deep washout — price is 25% below its 200-day, a broken primary trend. Measured: setups this stretched below the 200-day held the cycle low only ~37% of the time and drew a ~−22% tail (violent bounces, rarely the durable low). Treat as knife-risk — wait for it to reclaim the 10-day average and size small. The score above is already tempered for this.
ladder.bc_knife_line_zh: ⚠ 深度超卖——价格较 200 日均线低约 25%（主趋势已破）。实测：如此远低于 200 日线的形态，仅约 37% 守住周期低点，且回撤尾部约 −22%（反弹猛烈，但很少是持久低点）。视为「接飞刀」风险——等其收复 10 日均线后再小仓参与。上方分数已据此打折。

description.summary: Open Text Corporation designs, develops, markets, and sells information management software and solutions in North, Central, and South America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Australia, Japan, Singapore, India, and China. The company offers cloud services and subscriptions, including software as a service offerings, application programming interfaces and data services, and private, public, and off-cloud products, such as hosted services and managed service arrangements; foundational platform of technology services; and packaged business applications, as well as managed services and outsourced B2B integration solutions, including program implementation, operational management, and customer support. It also provides fees earned from the licensing of software products to customers; and consulting and learning services, such as implementation, training, and integration of licensed product offerings into the customer's systems. In addition, the company offers various business clouds, including content, cybersecurity, DevOps, business network, observability and service management, and analytics; and artificial intelligence, software developers API, and other related services. It has strategic partnerships with SAP SE, Google Cloud, Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Corporation, Oracle Corporation, and Salesforce.com Corporation, as well as global systems integrators, including Accenture plc, Capgemini Technology Services SAS, Deloitte Consulting LLP, Hewlett Packard Enterprises, and Tata Consultancy Services. The company serves G10K organizations, enterprise companies, public sector agencies, mid-market companies, small and medium-sized businesses, and direct consumers. Open Text Corporation was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Waterloo, Canada.
